# REQ: LANG-491 LANG-492 LANG-493 LANG-494
"""
A person in the system.
"""
type Person implements Node @key(fields: "id") {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  age: Int
  friends(first: Int = 10): [Person!]!
}

enum Role { ADMIN USER }

query GetPerson($id: ID!, $withFriends: Boolean = false) {
  person(id: $id) {
    name
    friends @include(if: $withFriends) { name }
  }
}

mutation { addPerson(name: "Ola", age: 30, active: true, note: null) { id } }

fragment Basic on Person { id name }
